title: Iridescence Material Expression (ver 6.0)
content: **Objective** Different colors of light are reflected depending on the angle of the screen. Holographic foil, vinyl, pearls, shells of shellfish can be expressed. The application result can be checked only in the render window. **Location** Fabric Property Editor▶ Material ▶ Type ▶ Iridescence**(Render Only)** ** Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location.** ****** 2. Edit the properties by referring to the table below. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- Color (1-5) | Set the color of each area to be reflected according to the 3D screen angle. Roughness | Adjust the roughness of the object surface. Hue Shift | Shift the entire color spectrum to a different hue changing the 5 colors together. Weight | Adjust the weight to reflect the set color on the object surface. 3. [Run](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014784747-Run-V-Ray-Render) the render window. → The iridescent material is applied
content_description: Explore the dynamic effects of iridescent materials in the Fabric Property Editor, where you can manipulate color, roughness, hue, and weight to visualize stunning light reflections in the render window.

title: User Setting (CFG) Open/Save
content: **List of Contents** Save Open **Objective** Save user settings such as language, measurement units, and shortcuts as a configuration file that can be applied to program updates. ** Location ** **Save** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ **User Setting** **Open ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ **User Setting** **Operation ** **Save** 1. Configure the [user settings](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000732727) as needed. 2. Locate the menu as below : Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ **User Setting** → The Save File window appears. 3. title: Trim (TRM) Open/Save
content: **List of Contents** Save Open **Objective** Save OBJ files as Trim files. Trim files can be previewed in the CLO Library and can [be glued to the Garment.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000526728-%EB%B6%80%EC%9E%90%EC%9E%AC-%EB%B6%99%EC%9D%B4%EA%B8%B0). ** Location ** **Save** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶**Trim** **Open ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ **Trim** **Operation ** **Save** 1. [Load an OBJ file as Trim](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000494107-3D-%ED%8C%8C%EC%9D%BC-OBJ-%EB%B6%88%EB%9F%AC%EC%98%A4%EA%B8%B0-%EB%82%B4%EB%B3%B4%EB%82%B4%EA%B8%B0#Click4). 2. Follow the indicated guideline below : Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶**Trim** → When there are multiple OBJs in the 3D window, tje Save Trim window appears allowing you to choose the desired OBJ. → The Save File window appears. 3. Locate the saving path and file name. Then, click the **Save** button. → The OBJ file is saved Trim file. **Open** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below : Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ **Trim** → The Open File window appears. 2. Select the file to be opened and click **Open**. → The Open Trim window appears. 3. Use the drop-down menu next to **Position** option to locate the Trim. → **Original:** trim is loaded at its original position when it was saved as a Trim file. → **Reset:** trim is loaded at the center of the 3D window. ※ Note: * Hover the mouse over the Trim file in the Library window to preview trim. * Click and drag or double lick the Trim file to open from the Library window. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to save and open OBJ files as Trim files in CLO, enabling users to preview and integrate them into garments effectively.

title: Animation Video Capture
content: ### **Objective** Create video captures of animations recorded in the Animation Mode. ### **Location** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Video Capture ▶ **Animation** ### **Operation** 1. Navigate to the Animation Mode. → The screen environment changes to Animation Mode. 2. [Record an animation](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000559488). 3. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Video Capture ▶ **Animation** → The Animation window with video capture settings appears. 4. Adjust the settings below as needed: Menu Item | Description ---|--- Video Size | Preset | Select from available presets for the video capture size. Orientation | Select the video capture orientation. Width | Input a specific pixel width for the video capture. Height | Input a specific pixel height for the video capture. Video Codec | Set the codec to use when recording video. **※ Note: **From ver 6.0, it is available to save MP4/AVI for Windows and MOV files for MAC without installing a separate codec. 5. Click on the **Record** button. → The animation video capture automatically starts from the beginning of the recorded Garment animation. 6. Click on the **Stop** button. → The animation video capture is completed and a preview window appears. 7. Click on the **Save** button in the preview window. → Navigate to a desired file location and input a desired file name in the window that appears. 8. Click on the **Save** button after navigating to the desired file location. → The animation video capture is saved. **※ Note:** While video recording, the main menu, 3D view controls, and Animation Editor functions cannot be used. Press the **Pause** button to pause the recording, then use the view controls to change the view, or use other functions. However, it is impossible to switch to other modes. To stop the video capture altogether, press Esc on the keyboard, click on **Cancel** , or **X** button on the top-right corner.
content_description: This page provides a step-by-step guide on how to capture and save video recordings of animations created in Animation Mode.

title: Motion (MTN) Open/Save
content: **Objective** Motion is a native file format (*mtn) of CLO that saves Avatar movement information, and is used when recording Animation of Garments and Avatars. CLO provides Motion files for its default male and female Avatars, but Animation Data or Motion capture Data from third-party 3D solutions can be imported as COLLADA files, then extracted as a Motion file (*mtn) through this menu. ** Location** **Open Motion** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ **Joint Motion** **Save Motion** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ **Joint Motion** ** Operation** **Open Motion** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ **Joint Motion** → The Open File window appears. 2. Navigate to the desired *mtn file, then click **Open**. → The Load Motion Type window appears. 3. Select from the available settings: **Garment Position** | **Move Avatar & Garment to Start Position** | Moves the Avatar and Garment to the location of the first frame (ver 2.5.0). ---|---|--- **Transition Animation** | A transition Animation is an Animation that changes from a T-Pose to a motion's first Pose in stages, and is created when the Avatar's current Pose and Motion differs from that of the first frame Pose. → The motion (*mtn) file loads according to the settings. **Save Motion** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ **Joint Motion** → The Save File window appears. 2. Type in file name and designate the path the file will be saved to. → The Motion (*mtn) file will be saved to the designated path. **※ Note:** * Motion files can only be saved when imported as Avatars in COLLADA format with Motion Data, and the COLLADA files must be in Open COLLADA format. * To learn more about COLLADA format, please reference [3D File (COLLADA) Import](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115000531948-3D%ED%8C%8C%EC%9D%BC-COLLADA-%EB%B6%88%EB%9F%AC%EC%98%A4%EA%B8%B0).
content_description: This web page provides instructions for opening and saving Motion files (*mtn) in CLO, facilitating the recording and importing of Avatar movement data for garment animations.

title: USB Plotter (ver 6.0)
content: **List of Contents** Plotter Share Settings Add Plotter Network ### **Objective** Install a Plotter of USB type to print the pattern. Install the driver for the connected plotter. Install the correct driver for the connected plotter model from each manufacturer's website. ** ** **** ### **Operation ** **Plotter Share Settings ** 1. Select the **Settings** by clicking the Start on the taskbar. 2. Select **Devices** and click the **Printers & Scanners** on the left → A list of connected printers and scanners appears. 3. After selecting the installed plotter, manage ▶ Printer Properties ▶ Sharing Tab ▶ Share this printer 4. Open File Explorer, enter **Network** in the address bar. 2. Click the computer where the plotter is connected to. → The plotter appears in the list of File Explorer. 3. Click the Plotter → The driver installation window appears. 4. Click **install the driver.** → The driver is installed and the plotter is added to the list of printers and scanners. 5. After completing the setting, [print the pattern to the plotter.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001557927-Plot-Patterns-Above-ver4-2-0-)

title: Snapshot - 3D Window
content: **List of Contents** 3D Window Snapshot Single View Multiview **3D Window Snapshot** \- Take a Snapshot of the 3D window in a single or multiple views. \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Snapshot ▶ **3D Window. ** \- Assign the saving path and the file name. Then, select **Save.** ** Single View** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8aMA5Ui_2Jk \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Snapshot ▶ **3D Window.** \- Assign the saving path and the file name. Then, select **Save.** \- When the Snapshot window appears, select the **Single** tab. \- Adjust the **Image Size** and the Options as needed. \- The Preset, Orientation, Width, Height, and the Unit can be adjusted under the Image Size section while options such as Transparent Background and Save All Colors can be toggled on/off under the Options section. \- Select the **Reset** button to change all settings back to default values. **-** Show Garment Measurements in the 3D snapshots. Take the 3D snapshot while the Show Garment Measurement icon is activated (ver4.1.0). \- Select the **Save** button to save the snapshot. **Multiview** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=amClLCDMw-E \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Snapshot ▶ **3D Window.** \- Assign the saving path and the file name. Then, select **Save.** \- When the Snapshot window appears, select the **Multiview** Tab. \- Adjust the Image Size, Layout, and the Options as needed. \- The Preset, Orientation, Width, Height, and the Unit can be adjusted under the Image Size section. \- The View Count and the Layout options can be modified under the Layout section. \- The Transparent Background, Save Separate Images, and the Save All Colorways options can be toggled on/off under the Options section. \- Select the **Reset** button to change all settings back to default values. \- Apply current zoom state of the 3D window to multi-snapshot preview (ver4.1.0). **-** Show Garment Measurements in the 3D snapshots. Take the 3D snapshot while the Show Garment Measurement icon is activated (ver4.1.0). \- Select the **Save** button to save the snapshot. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to capture and save 3D window snapshots in both single and multiview formats, including detailed instructions and video resources.

title: Print Layout 2D Snapshot
content: ### **Objective** Save pattern layout as an image file in Print Layout mode. ### **Location** Main Menu **▶** Change the mode at the top-right corner**▶ PRINT LAYOUT** ### **Operation** 1. Select the tool/ menu indicated in Location. → Simulation mode is changed to Print Layout Mode. 2. Click on the **Save Image** icon at the top-left of the 2D window. → The 2D Snapshot window appears. 3. Arrange patterns onto fabric in the 2D window. Be mindful of outline markers while arranging the patterns. 4. Set the size along with other options for the snapshot. Option --- **Preset** | Select from a variety of presets. **Orientation** | Select the paper orientation. **Width** | Set the width of the image. **Height** | Set the height of the image. **Unit** | Set the unit of the print paper. **Resolution** | Set the resolution of the snapshot image. **Line/Image/Info** | Select the line, the image, and the information that will appear in the Print Layout 2D snapshot. **Fabric Texture Opacity (ver 6.1)** | Adjust the opacity of the fabric and texture. 5. Set the image file format(PNG / JPEG / PDF (ver 6.1))for 2D Snapshot, name the file, locate the saving path, and click **Save**. → Print Layout 2D Snapshot is saved.
content_description: This web page guides users through the process of saving a pattern layout as an image file in Print Layout mode, ensuring optimal arrangement and customization of their designs.

content: **Objective** Save 3D State for each size to review by grading size. **Location ** Object Browser ▶ Grading ▶ **Pair Avatar** **Operation** 1. After [adding](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015578947-Add-Adjust-Grading) and [editing](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015798567-Edit-Grading) the grading, click the Pair Avatar tab and click Update. → The list in the size tab appears the same. → The Avatar in the 3D window is applied to all sizes by default. → If there are two or more size groups, they are combined and displayed based on the Base Size. 2. Select the tool/menu as indicated. 2. Click on the Pattern outline where the seam allowance is on. → Seam allowance options in the property editor. 3. title: Why am I unable to log in to Help Center on iOS devices (or in the Safari app)?
content: **Q:** Why am I unable to log in to Help Center on iOS devices? **A:** Sometimes users encounter login issues when accessing the Help Center on their iOS device or using Safari. These issues are caused by the "Prevent cross-site tracking" setting, which blocks certain login data from being saved during the redirection process. This setting needs to be disabled in order for users to log in using Safari because the login process relies on cross-site tracking. By default, this setting is turned on, but users can manually disable it to resolve the issue. Apple's Help Center provides instructions on how to disable this setting, which can be found in the articles "[Prevent cross-site tracking in Safari on Mac](https://support.apple.com/en-gb/guide/safari/sfri40732/mac)" or "[Browse privately in Safari on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-gb/guide/iphone/iphb01fc3c85/ios#:~:text=Go%20to%20Settings%20%3E%20Safari%2C%20then,to%20allow%20cross%2Dsite%20tracking)".
content_description: This web page provides guidance on resolving login issues to the Help Center on iOS devices by adjusting Safari's "Prevent cross-site tracking" settings.

title: Payment failure notification
content: **QUESTION** Why was my payment not processed? **ANSWER** CLO payments can fail for several reasons. Each type of failure is handled differently. Please check if your case falls under the below categories and proceed with the solution: **Insufficient funds:** Try a different payment method or retry the payment at a later date. **Incorrect card number:** Try again with the correct number. **Card expiration:** Check the expiration date of your payment method. If it has expired, try again with a different one. [How can I update my billing information?](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013509248-How-can-I-update-my-billing-information-) **Alipay & WeChat Issue:** If you cannot use Alipay payment or cannot successfully renew subscriptions, please check the following article for more information: [What will I do when met Alipay/WeChat issue? (CN)](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/zh-cn/articles/9445178183321-%E6%94%AF%E4%BB%98%E5%AE%9D-%E5%BE%AE%E4%BF%A1%E4%BB%98%E6%AC%BE%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%E6%80%8E%E4%B9%88%E5%8A%9E-) **Online transactions with Indian banks:** Please enable international transactions. Check the following article to review how to do this: [How to successfully make payments: Applicable to users with Indian Bank accounts & Cards.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/12404983545625-How-to-successfully-make-payments-Applicable-for-the-users-with-Indian-Bank-accounts-Cards-) **Payment restrictions on Russia and Belarus** Due to international sanctions imposed, payments related to Russian financial institutions may not be processed. Please check the following article for more information: [[Important Notice] Payment restrictions on Russia and Belarus](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/4651014787993--Important-Notice-Payment-restrictions-on-Russia-and-Belarus) **Other reasons:** If all the card information seems correct, please contact your issuing bank for more information, or try a different payment method. If your issue is not linked to any of the above reasons, but you are still receiving this message, please[ contact us.](https://www.clo3d.com/en/support/contactus)
content_description: This web page provides guidance on resolving payment processing issues for CLO transactions, detailing common reasons for failures and corresponding solutions.

title: Emails from CLO are filtered as spam by Gmail.
content: **Question** Emails from CLO are filtered as spam by Gmail. **Answer** If you did not receive emails from CLO including the invoice and reply for your inquiry, and later found the emails in your spam folder - please follow the steps below. [STEP 1] **Mark incorrectly classified emails as Not spam** Go to your spam folder and open the email from CLO. Click on the 'Report not spam' button at the top. Gmail uses machine learning to recognize spam. So you need to mark CLO emails as not spam manually to let Gmail learn your behavior. [STEP 2] **Set up a filter on Gmail** If CLO emails are still sent to the spam folder after trying STEP 1, create a new filter in your Gmail inbox _not to report CLO emails as spam_. 1\. Open Gmail. 2\. In the search box at the top, click Show search options. 3\. Enter your search criteria; _ex)_ From: [support@clo3d.zendesk.com](mailto:support@clo3d.zendesk.com) or Has the words: CLO3d 4\. At the bottom of the search window, click Create filter. 5\. Check 'Never send it to Spam' 6\. Click Create filter.
content_description: This page provides step-by-step instructions to help you ensure emails from CLO are delivered to your inbox instead of being filtered as spam by Gmail.

title: How to successfully make payments: Applicable for the users with Indian Bank accounts & Cards.
content: **Note-**_According to the RBI Guidelines, Debit/Credit Cards issued to customers including new, reissued, renewed or upgraded cards, will be enabled for Domestic ATM and Point of Sale (POS)/physical transactions only. The cards will be disabled for Online, Contactless and International transactions to protect against fraud. In addition, if customers have not used their existing card for online, contactless or international transactions in the last 3 years (including card issues or new accounts opened during this period), usage for these purposes will be mandatorily disabled. However, the limits can be set up & the usage can be enabled for any disabled transaction by simply logging into respective Bank Online or Mobile App._ **Steps for enabling “International transactions” are as follows:** **HDFC Bank** **Mobile App*** Step 1: **Login** to HDFC Mobile Banking App. Step 2: **Select ‘** Pay’ > **Select** ‘Cards‘ from the main menu. Step 3: **Select** 'Debit Card’ > **Select** ‘Customized’. Step 4**:****Scroll & Select** ‘International’ > Enable the ‘Disabled’ option > **Select** ‘Confirm’. Step 5: **Check and Enter** the OTP received on your registered mobile number. **Net Banking*** Step 1: **Sign-in** to HDFC NetBanking. Step 2: From your dashboard, **Select** ‘Cards’. Step 3: **Select** ‘Debit Cards’. Step 4: **Select** ‘Request’. Step 5: **Click** on ‘Set international Usage’. Step 6: **Select** ‘Card to be enabled for International use’. Step 7: **Enter** any additional card details if requested & **select** ‘submit’. **ICICI Bank** **Mobile App*** Step 1: **Login** to the iMobile App. Step 2: **Select** ‘Credit/Debit Card’ > **Select** ‘Manage Card’ from the main menu. Step 3: **Select** ‘Credit/Debit Card’ for which international transactions are desired. Step 4: Under ‘Manage Card’ > **Select** ‘Transaction Settings’. Step 5: **Select** ‘International’ > Click to continue. Step 6: **Select** ‘Confirm’ to allow international credit card transactions. **Net Banking*** Step 1: **Open** https://www.icicibank.com/ > **Select** ‘Personal Banking’ option. Step 2: **Login** by adding your NetBanking ‘User ID and Password’. Step 3: **Select** ‘Cards and Loans’ from the main menu > **select** ‘Credit/Debit Card’ from the sub-menu. Step 4: **Select** ‘Manage Card’ > **Scroll & Select** the ‘International Section’. Step 5: **Tap** to ‘Enable’ and manage limits of the transaction for ATM, Online, Merchant Outlet, etc. Step 6**: Submit** by verifying with OTP to activate international transactions. **KOTAK Mahindra Bank** **Mobile App*** Step 1: **Login** to Kotak Mobile Banking App. Step 2: In ‘Service Request’ **Select** ‘Debit Card’. Step 3: **Select** ‘Card Control’. Step 4: **Scroll & Select** your ‘Debit Card Number’. Step 5: **Select** ‘International/Domestic Controls’. Step 6: **Select** ‘On/Off’ for International Usage. **Net Banking*** Step 1: **Login** to Kotak Net Banking. Step 2: **Select** the “Debit Card section’ Option. Step 3: **Select** ‘Card Control’. Step 4: **Enable** ‘International Usage’ on ATM withdrawal, Transactions at retail outlets/merchant stores and E-Com transactions. _*You can also set your daily International ATM, POS and ECOM transaction limit according to your preference. Simply change your ATM, POS and ECOM limits in ‘Limit Management/Controls’ on Kotak Mobile Banking App or Kotak NetBanking page. *_ **SBI- State Bank of India** **Mobile App* (Yono)** Step 1: **Login** to Yono Mobile App. Step 2: **Select** ‘Services’. Step 3: **Select** ‘Manage Debit Card’. Step 4: **Select** your ‘Account’ from the dropdown Step 5: **Select** your ‘Debit card number’. Step 6: **Scroll & Enable** the ‘International usage’. **Net Banking*** Step 1: **Login** to SBI NetBanking. Step 2: **Select** ‘Services’ from the main menu Step 3: **Select** ‘Manage Card Usage’. Step 4: **Change** the transaction type from ‘Domestic’ to ‘International’ **CITI Bank** **Mobile App*** Steps to Enable your card for international transactions. [Enable your Citi Card for Online, Contactless and International Transactions (citibank.co.in)](https://www.online.citibank.co.in/citihelp/topics/cards/transactions-security-enhancement/index.htm#:~:text=You%20can%20enable%20your%20card%20for%20international%2C%20contactless,International%20usage%20or%20setup%20limit%20for%20Online%20transactions)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for customers to enable international transactions on their debit and credit cards, in compliance with RBI guidelines, ensuring secure access to global services.

title: Customer Security Alert: Sara Saarinen is not working for CLO.
content: We recently discovered that some users are receiving job proposals from Sara Saarinen, who is posing as a CLO employee. CLO Team would like to alert you that Sara Saarinen does not work for us; we do not associate with this person or hire models. If you receive an email from [sara.saarinen.modelling@gmail.com](mailto:sara.saarinen.modelling@gmail.com), please do not send any videos or photos. This scammer uses email to trick you into giving them personal information. **What can I do to****avoid that situation****?** 1. Be cautious whenever you receive an email requesting personal information. 2. If suspicious, do not click on any link and go directly to [CLO Website](https://www.clo3d.com/) to verify this information. If you have any questions or concerns, you can directly reach out to us via [Contact Us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). 3. Never send personal or financially sensitive information via email. 4. Check the sender's address. CLO never uses public domains to communicate with our users. Updated information: Salla Suoranta (salla.suoranta.clo3d@gmail.com) also does not work for CLO. It is also a scammer and the same information explained above applies to it as well.
content_description: This webpage serves to inform users about fraudulent job proposals from impersonators claiming to be CLO employees, providing essential tips on how to recognize and avoid these scams.
